subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost cold-thread recovery intentionally add one bounded awaited REST fetch per stored thread session and suppress retries after that fetch fails?
rationale: Both choices affect real users: retrying can repeatedly delay inbound turns during an outage, while no-retry can leave recovered context unavailable for the rest of a session after a transient failure; repository evidence does not establish the permanent owner policy.

options.title: Accept the bounded one-attempt policy
options.body: Approve the current behavior after refreshing the branch and checks, accepting that transient failures require session rotation before another recovery attempt.

options.title: Add a bounded transient retry policy
options.body: Differentiate failed and completed markers so a narrowly capped retry can recover from temporary Mattermost failures without retrying every turn.

options.title: Pause the inbound recovery approach
options.body: Keep the bug open and close or redesign this PR if owner policy rejects any awaited Mattermost request on the inbound path.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded one-attempt policy
recommendation.body: Approve the current behavior after refreshing the branch and checks, accepting that transient failures require session rotation before another recovery attempt.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline routes Mattermost review to this person, and the unresolved choice concerns Mattermost-specific inbound behavior rather than a generic core API.
